correctness.rationale: For each false world y the failed coalitions are exactly subsets of C(y). Maximal failed signatures are precisely the mandatory nonempty false cells, leading to exact independent products. All agreement cells are nonempty under n_i>=2, establishing every ideal. The grand-only event uses k disjoint cells of sizes n_i-1 and p(o) true; Bernoulli independence proves the event probability and logarithmic expansion yields the sharp threshold. The direct semantic enumeration through 74,832 valuations agrees, without purporting to prove the infinite-parameter theorem.

value.rationale: The complete epistemic profile classification and all-size exact fiber count quantify genuine ambiguity in how valuations realize coalition information. The grand-only event has a sharp, variable-dimensional transition, describing when distributed group knowledge emerges without any proper coalition being knowledgeable. Unlike plain Dedekind counting, the new parameter-dependent fibers and probabilistic law reveal substantive model-sensitive structure.
